I couldn't schedule the Monday digest, so nothing is set up. The scheduler rejected my request with a credentials error, so the first digest won't post on Monday 19 Oct.

I replied to Bettina in the thread on her message in #coastal-team. I told her:
- **Plan:** post "Coastal week ahead" in #coastal-team every Monday at 08:00 Central.
- **Content:** last week's messages and open customer items, taken only from #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Everyone in those two channels is on the Coastal team. It would leave out finance figures and anything from DMs.
- **Fix needed:** someone with admin access has to fix the scheduler.
- **Until then:** she can ping me on a Monday and I'll post the digest by hand.
